notes.title: RavenHeart Hospital: A Medical Visual Novel | Steam Game Festival Quick Pitch
notes.content:
[h1]Doctor: we are ready to begin the operation![/h1]
Inspired by the Trauma Center series and LifeSigns, RavenHeart Hospital: A Medical Visual Novel is a surgery simulation visual novel. Take on the role of an ace surgeon in training at the world's greatest hospital and learn from the best of the best in a variety of specializations: veterinary, pediatrics, neurology, EMS, and more!


[h2]Do you think love can bloom even in the operating room?[/h2]
Befriend and romance a colorful cast of doctors.
Will you melt Dante's spicy heart, or will you swoon over Big Tex's southern charm?
The choice is up to you!


[h2]Player-Created Stories & Operations[/h2]
Do you have the perfect character you want to see at RavenHeart Hospital?

Do you have an idea for a crazy operation?

Or perhaps you want to write a prequel about medical school (or what RavenHeart would be like as a magical high school!)

Write your own stories, characters, and operations and share them with the community! RavenHeart Hospital features an easy-to-use scripting language and a drag-n-drop interface to play community-crafted content easily.
